description.short_caption: Erythematous papule with surrounding redness on the back.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a portion of the back with a prominent erythematous papule at the center. The lesion is surrounded by mild redness, and there are scattered smaller red macules in the surrounding skin. The image is well-lit, and the lesion is clearly visible against the lighter skin tone.

description.short_caption: Small ulcerated lesion with surrounding erythema on the leg.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a small, round, ulcerated lesion on the skin of the leg. The lesion has a dark, crusted center surrounded by a rim of erythema, suggesting inflammation. The surrounding skin appears otherwise unremarkable, with no visible signs of extensive swelling or additional lesions. The lesion's appearance is consistent with a localized infectious or inflammatory process.

description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on the leg.

The lesions are discrete and do not appear to coalesce. The surrounding skin appears normal without significant edema or scaling. The photograph is well-lit, and the lesions are clearly visible.
